title: General features and answers
summary: Feedback in this topic is loosely clustered around broad impressions of the car and dealer experience, plus comments about how clearly features and answers are explained.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car’s general features and express overall satisfaction with the car and dealer experience.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize vague AI or dealer answers and difficulty getting clear responses to questions.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention broad impressions, touchscreen learning, expected build quality, missing feature coverage, and feature explanations without a clear overall sentiment.

limitations: This topic mixes broad overall impressions with specific comments about AI answers, dealer responses, manuals, videos, touchscreen use, and feature explanations.
Most fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits how specifically the sentiment pattern can be summarized.
Examples are insufficient to draw a more coherent single theme beyond general impressions and information or explanation issues.
